hit.tipOrPedalRule: active endpoint inside target tolerance ellipse
hit.jointPolicy: solve shoulder→elbow→wrist→hand→stick or hip→knee→ankle→boot without reverse bend

rebound.summary: recover from the same hit pose, not a second independent pose
rebound.continuity: preserve identity, camera, torso, stool, inactive limbs

specialAttention: Do not copy local geometry from FAIL references
simultaneous targets must be satisfied in the same single body pose
inactive limbs must remain close to neutral/PASS anchors
